title: Canonical supported Ext representative on the projective-line product
statement: Let \(A\) be a commutative ring, \(N\in\mathbb N\) with \(N=0\) in \(A\), and \(S\) a scheme. Write \(P=\mathbb P^1_S\), \(W=P\times_S P\), and \(i:P\to W\) for the diagonal. Use the constant sheaf, finite Tate line and degree-zero complexes of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], the ordinary derived direct image of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], and the exact supported Ext realization of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. For any \(\kappa\in\operatorname{Ext}^2(i_*A_P,\mathcal L_W)\), define supportedMap from \(Ri_*A_P[0]\) to \(\mathcal L_W[0][2]\) as the canonical exact-direct-image/single-functor comparison followed by the derived morphism representing \(\kappa\). This is the existing supportedExactDerivedMap specialized to \(i\), the constant sheaf on \(P\), and the finite Tate line on \(W\). Both endpoints are the fixed ordinaryFinitePushforward, ordinaryFiniteUnit and shifted ordinaryFiniteLine endpoints. No existence witness or integral identity is used; the construction, signature and irreducibility attribute are unchanged from its original module.

lean.statement:
def supportedMap (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    (κ : Ext
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine S)))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) N A hA) 2) :
    (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
